messages.subject: Executive Profile | GCC Energy, ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Zack,

I am reaching out directly after a message to maptalent's general mailbox was rejected by the receiving server. Given maptalent's work across mid-to-senior management and C-suite recruitment in the Middle East, including energy, infrastructure and development, I would value your consideration or referral to the colleague best aligned with my profile.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans ESG and sustainability, government and regulatory relations, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and country-facing coordination within a major international mining operation.

My work requires sustained engagement with ministries, regulators, public institutions, communities, industry bodies and senior corporate leadership. I also support governance and external positioning around a large solar and battery-storage platform, carbon-accounting work and wider sustainability priorities.

I am exploring senior GCC mandates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and Kuwait, particularly Country Director or Representative, Executive Director, Director or Head of Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, External Affairs, Stakeholder Engagement and Country Operations. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

My current GCC executive CV is attached. I would appreciate consideration for relevant searches or an internal referral to the appropriate maptalent practice lead.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | ESG | Corporate Affairs | Government Relations
